recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration develop a more structured approach to the implementation of multilingual mandates, including by prioritizing high-impact content and the continuous use of artificial intelligence and other translation technologies with human oversight and quality assurance, and aligning staffing and workflow arrangements with the objective of achieving parity among the six official languages.
